question: Do the retained broader GEO series identify an unassessed publicly measured authentic native EMC treatment/control, time-course or orthogonal assay cohort that permits a useful new empirical contrast beyond existing campaign decisions?
selection_before_outcomes: First inspect only cached title/taxon/assay/sample count/accession fields for all 53 records. Reconcile known evaluated sources. Select at most two genuinely linked native EMC or broader primary sarcoma cohorts with potentially informative native perturbation/time/orthogonal contexts; freeze exact source selections before methods/condition reads. No numerical values or favorable gene selection.

source_catalogue.scope: complete metadata retrieval for that exact washout/withdrawal/recovery sarcoma query, not a complete EMC source search or condition evaluation

known_reuse: All verified R1-R9 source/eligibility decisions; GSE98824 all30 breast-PDX conditions/six models unsuitable for native EMC, not repeated. Prior DDR/native screen/fusion/CAM/redox decisions unchanged.
allowed: Identity, all model/donor/specimen/condition labels, assay/library methods, technical repeats, controls, public data availability and actual primary links only. Primary methods/condition extracts read with relevant outcome values masked.
excluded: No expression or biochemical values before concrete useful prospective contrast and lead review; no portal/static RNA panel/clock/IR/APA/chemokine/13-case proliferation/washout-paper rescue; no denied FAP/glycan/HLA/structural content, disputed/generic models as native EMC, private/account credentials or unchanged failed-route repetition.
useful_addition: A new authenticated same-donor intervention/time-series or orthogonal assay can motivate a specific next measurement only if it separates a pathway response from growth/culture/treatment/mixture effects with appropriate controls and adds to prior art. Merely recovering a source or catalogue does not qualify.
strongest_alternatives: Generic sarcoma or disputed cell line identity rather than native EMC.
Technical repeats or shared donors masquerading as independent conditions.
Culture selection, time/batch or nonspecific growth effects rather than a new EMC phenotype.
An already published contrast or assay surrogate cannot establish new dependency/mechanism.
defeat: No newly authenticated native EMC conditions, absent matched controls/assay/condition maps, prior art already establishing the contrast, or only excluded static/context-free data means scoped inconclusive/source NO-GO without RNA or biochemical rescue.
coverage: All 53 unreconciled underlying cohorts/conditions remain pending unless an exact prior evaluation or actual source check supports disposition. Metadata screening is not all-condition evidence evaluation; suitable public pending data blocks promotion.
owner: functional_new/broader_native_assay_followthrough only; integrating lead owns shared state/main/push; fapi_named separate independent source/value/omission challenge
storage: Whole catalogue/source methods originals ignored; no recopy retained catalogue; compact evaluated subset/source hashes/receipts/negative-inconclusive decisions exported; original freezes immutable
